At each session\'s close, the top 10 stocks that were STRONG (score 75+) are that day\'s picks. Their return runs from that day\'s close to the close 1, 5 and 10 sessions later, with the Nifty 50\'s return over the same days beside it. The first days come from running the same score formula on past prices (a backtest); later days join with each scan. Past performance doesn\'t promise the future.

While the market is open (Mon–Fri 9:15–3:30) the app runs a full scan by itself at the chosen interval, even with the app closed. During the day today\'s volume is incomplete, so RVOL counts it as an estimate of the whole day — taking into account that mornings trade more (the ≈ mark on the card). New STRONG stocks and breakouts come as notifications. Android may run it late or stop it to save battery — allow it with \"Let it run in the background\" in Menu → Scan.

Every ★ stock\'s trade plan is watched. When the price crosses the breakout trigger you get a notification, and that plan is then fixed: a notification at every target and when the stop-loss breaks. If a stock is already above its trigger when first watched, the alert comes only when it falls back and breaks out again.
Menu → Track record shows each day\'s top 10 STRONG picks and their return 1, 5 and 10 days later, beside the Nifty 50 — so you can see how well the score works.

Each stock\'s sector comes from NSE\'s/BSE\'s classification (Capital Goods, Healthcare, Financial Services…). In Menu → Scan turn sectors on or off for NSE, SME and BSE each — the scan covers only the stocks of the sectors that are on. Stocks with no known sector (mostly SME) are under \"Other\". See the sectors\' strength from the \"Sectors\" chip and tap one to filter the list to it.

Logged in through Menu → Account, the ★ Watchlist is kept in your account in the cloud: log in to the same account on another phone and the same stocks show, and starring or unstarring on one phone changes the other too. Without a login the watchlist stays on this phone only.
